quote_boxes.en: A friend of mine from Mondstadt would always bring a few bottles of locally brewed dandelion wine whenever he came to visit me in Liyue.
quote_boxes.speaker: Zhongli
quote_boxes.t: 내 몬드 친구는 리월에 나를 만나러 올 때마다 현지에서 빚은 dandelion wine을 몇 병씩 가져오곤 했다.
